payload.title: 12-Week Advanced Muscle-Gain Program (Kettlebell + Band + Pull-Up Bar)
payload.summary: A 5-day/week, 12-week push/pull/legs + upper/lower program for an advanced trainee working with only a kettlebell, resistance bands, a pull-up bar, and bodyweight. Progresses through reps, tempo, and reduced rest since equipment limits simple load jumps, with a week-9 deload.
safety_notes: No injuries were confirmed; exercise selection still favors controllable, joint-friendly movements appropriate for unsupervised training.

Before Kettlebell Swings specifically (Day 3): spend 1-2 minutes on hip hinge/glute activation (e.g. a few slow bodyweight glute bridges) before swinging — swinging cold is a common way to tweak the lower back.
The week-9 deload is intentional — resist the urge to push through it at full volume.
payload.revision_notes: Version 2: addressed user feedback on final_draft version 1 — added a kettlebell-swing-specific warm-up note under Safety Notes, and added the ~45 min session-time estimate to each day's heading (both in weekly_schedule.day_label here and in the Session-by-Session Program section headings in program_preview.md).
